finding: Happy Glamper was represented as a fixed Merricks stay even though its general tent service travels to guest-selected sites. Its Balnarring Deluxe fee and seasonal terms were mixed with general tent hire, and the Peninsula Hot Springs extra was given an unsupported old name. Woodman Estate chalet copy asserted over-water construction, daily housekeeping, breakfast delivery and rowboat access, while omitting shared grounds, limited Wi-Fi and a kitchenette without stove or oven.
hypothesis: Anchor each page to a current bookable accommodation format, identify inclusions and shared space before the visitor leaves for booking, and remove unsupported benefits to improve decision trust.
boundedChange: Reframe Happy Glamper as the named Balnarring Deluxe tent at Balnarring Foreshore Reserve and remove the false Merricks point; describe the separate campground booking needed for other mobile setups. Reframe Woodman as separately bookable lakeside chalets, link the current manager and one chalet booking page, identify shared estate grounds and the separate whole-estate option, and remove unsupported amenities. Review hero images separately before release. Replace the two mismatched and inadequately credited vineyard fallbacks with source-hash-verified Balnarring Beach and Devilbend Reservoir photographs. Label both as regional illustrations rather than property photos, expose photographer, source and licence links, and reject uncredited CMS hero overrides on these two pages, cards and social images. Set the Balnarring Beach tent zone to Western Port; the existing Balnarring place page remains under Red Hill and Merricks, a cross-taxonomy issue for a later place-model review.

negativeFindings: Happy Glamper is a mobile service based on the Peninsula; Merricks was not a verified accommodation address. The Balnarring Deluxe option has a named campsite and included site fee, so the Stay record now points to that product and omits coordinates.
Other Happy Glamper campsite stays require a separately booked and paid campsite. The operator page lists an optional Bath House pass, not the former Spa Dreaming Centre wording.
Woodman chalet bookings share the 50-acre estate grounds with other accommodations. The manager lists limited Wi-Fi and no stove or oven in the chalet.

Woodman manager pages do not list daily housekeeping, delivered breakfast or a rowboat as chalet inclusions. The current booking page describes chalets at the waters edge, not constructed over the lake.

Both old hero images were unrelated vineyard scenes. The Happy Glamper credit disagreed with LICENSES.md; Woodman had no matching source entry. They were replaced with hash-verified, visibly disclosed regional photographs. Neither replacement depicts the accommodation.

The first rendered build still used CMS overrides with generic alt and no source/credit, hiding both licensed fallbacks. Extended the existing three-path metadata guard to these two venues; final rendered acceptance is pending.

The prior ocean-coast and draft bay-coast zone labels did not describe Balnarring Beach. Western Port is the geographic coast; the Balnarring place reference is still grouped with Red Hill and Merricks in the place taxonomy.

Coverage is counted from the 27 actual listable Stay records, requiring an attributable editorialProvenance.source and a reviewedOn or checkedOn date of 2026-09-30 or later. The last live release had 21; this set brings it to 23 if published. Four records have no such source receipt. Several public lastVerified fields still predate their source reviews and need separate reconciliation.
